feeds.title: New Zealand's Autocar Magazine
feeds.description: NZ Autocar is New Zealand's leading car magazine with news, reviews, and analysis from the automotive world. Our car mag website provides commentary and in-depth features on the car industry, motorsport, and innovative vehicle tech. Covers the scope of motoring including new cars, classic cars, EVs, and motorbikes.

feeds.title: Racelab NZ Blog
feeds.description: Racelab are importers and distributors for Sabelt, PIAA and DTG products in New Zealand plus Walero products both in Australia and New Zealand. If you are interested in selling these products please get in touch. Racelab has all the racing accessories and equipment covered Sablet Walero Racetech Stilo Braid Wheels Piaa Speedflow DTG Marine Helmets. Visit their blog and learn more about their services, products, past clients, racing news and updates.

feeds.title: JIM BARCLAY Blog
feeds.description: Jim Barclay is a former RNZAF pilot who flew a number of jet fighter aircraft, including the Vampire, Strikemaster and Skyhawk as well as the F4 Phantom with the USAF. An avid motor sport enthusiast, Jim attended his first race meetings at Levin in 1956 and he has followed the sport nationally and internationally since then. He now own and races and 1961 historic single-seat racing car. Learn more about him through his informative blog.

feeds.title: Trofeo Series Blog
feeds.description: The Trofeo Series is a group of Alfa Romeo, Fiat & Lancia drivers who race each year, in a fun, friendly, competitive contest. Go through their blog and learn more about the Trofeo Series, past events, highlights, series predictions, feature stories, news, and updates.

feeds.title: MotorSport New Zealand Blog
feeds.description: MotorSport New Zealand is a not-for-profit National Sporting Organisation appointed by the FIA as the sole authority to regulate motorsport in New Zealand.MotorSport New Zealand Inc was initially inaugurated in October 1947 as the Association of New Zealand Car Clubs. Incorporation was achieved in November 1950 and in 1967 with a membership of 58 clubs the name was changed to Motorsport Association of New Zealand Inc.

feeds.description: New Zealands Festival of Drift Motorsport, created in 2015, Drift Matsuri has grown to become a destination event for all drivers and fans from the around the country to attend!
